name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.idxL_ofFn
typeText:
∀ (n r : Nat) (args : Fin r → Fin n),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.idxL n (List.map.{0, 0} Fin.val (List.ofFn.{0} args)))
    (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(args i)) (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} n ↑i))

source.code:
theorem idxL_ofFn (n : ℕ) : ∀ (r : ℕ) (args : Fin r → Fin n),
    idxL n ((List.ofFn args).map Fin.val) = ∑ i, (args i).1 * n ^ (i : ℕ)
  | 0, _ => by simp [idxL]
  | r + 1, args => by
      rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.map_cons]
      simp only [idxL, List.foldr_cons] at *
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      have := idxL_ofFn n r (fun i => args i.succ)
      simp only [idxL] at this
      rw [this, Finset.mul_sum]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, Fin.val_succ, pow_succ]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
